summary: Iteration 9 major expansion tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed for Expenses CRUD+payments+RBAC, Uploads (PDF accepted, .exe/oversized rejected, file served), Reports (aging bucket + days_overdue accurate for TE/2026-27/0001, GST settlement ITC math, P&L populated, Balance Sheet identity holds within 0.05), and WhatsApp reminder deep link (wa.me, bank details, invoice number in message). Frontend: Login, Expenses (add dialog fills correctly, preview total ₹1,180.00, row appears with expected data), Reports (FY-2026-27 preset resolves to 2026-04-01→2027-03-31 exactly, all 3 tabs render, gst-net-total renders ₹6,562.37), Reconciliation aging cards show correct amounts (0-30=₹44,200, others ₹0). ONE CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: whatsapp-remind-{inv_no} and email-remind-{inv_no} buttons are NOT wired in Reconciliation row — handlers sendWhatsAppReminder / sendEmailReminder exist (lines 56-71) but there is no <button> in the row action cell (line 183-187) calling them. All disposable data cleaned.

ui_bugs.issue: WhatsApp and Email reminder buttons are missing from unpaid invoice rows. sendWhatsAppReminder and sendEmailReminder handlers exist but no <button data-testid=\"whatsapp-remind-{inv_no}\"> nor <button data-testid=\"email-remind-{inv_no}\"> is rendered. Only 'Log Payment' button is shown.
Delete (Trash2 icon) button has no data-testid — hard to target from tests. Suggested: data-testid={`expense-delete-${e.bill_number}`}.

action_items: Add whatsapp-remind-{inv_no} and email-remind-{inv_no} buttons in Reconciliation.jsx row action cell (~line 183). Only render when inv.status !== 'paid'. Email button only when inv.customer?.email exists.
Add data-testid to the Trash2 delete button in Expenses row (~line 182) for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1102 lines — approaching split threshold (>700). Consider modularising into routers/ (auth, invoices, expenses, uploads, reports).
GET /api/uploads/{fid} is public (no auth) — acceptable given unguessable UUID filenames, but document this choice.
compute_expense_totals treats 'discount' as absent; ExpenseLine has no discount field. OK for MVP; note asymmetry vs invoice LineItem which supports discount.

Balance sheet accounting identity holds because proprietor_capital is derived as (Assets - Liab - RE). This is a plug figure, not a real capital account. Fine for MVP but flag for real accounting later.
P&L expense categorisation: COGS heuristic ('Raw Material' + 'Logistics') is hard-coded. Consider making category-to-COGS mapping configurable.
gst-settlement includes ALL invoices when no date filter provided — fine, but Reports.jsx should always pass from/to.
seed_data_creation: Disposable expenses (TEST_Vendor_GJ, TEST_ITC_Vendor, V-QA-*) and one PDF upload were created during tests and DELETED after. Uploads directory cleaned. TE/2026-27/0001 invoice preserved and untouched. Ephemeral test staff user teststaff+<ts>@trayambak.in created and deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints for iter-9 expansion work correctly. Preview state at test end: 1 invoice (TE/2026-27/0001, balance 44200, pending), 0 expenses, 0 credit notes, 0 uploaded files on disk, invoice counter seq=1. Only remaining functional gap is the two missing reminder buttons in Reconciliation.jsx row action cell. After main agent wires them (should be a ~5 line change), retest with a quick playwright click on whatsapp-remind-TE/2026-27/0001 (should open new tab to wa.me/...) and email-remind-TE/2026-27/0001 (mailto:).
